title: Moonwalker Descending Neurons Mediate Visually Evoked Retreat in Drosophila.
quote: Here, we present data from functional imaging, behavioral epistasis, and unilateral activation experiments that support these hypotheses.
mapping_basis: Paper names 'moonwalker descending neurons (MDNs)'; MDN is the MANC type name (DNp50 literature synonym).
notes: Abstract only (full text 403 at publisher; not in PMC/Europe PMC). The supported hypothesis, stated just before the quote, is that 'turning while walking backward might reflect asymmetric activation of the left and right MDNs'; so unilateral MDN activation is reported to support backward walking with turning. Legs coded yes by the backward-walking convention. The abstract does not state the effector, stimulus, driver line or preparation: effector_kind is left null on purpose (not a schema enum value) rather than guessed, and preparation is 'other' (unknown). Bilateral MDN activation is cited to earlier work [19], not tested here per the abstract.
